latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Bangla Free — an AI skill for converting Bangla text scripts into ready-to-share videos:

- Upload Bangla scripts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, up to 200MB) and generate 1080p MP4 videos with visuals and AI voiceover.
- Easy, code-free workflow: just upload your script and describe your needs to create videos—no editing skills required.
- Provides session and credit management (100 free credits for new users, 7-day validity).
- Tracks project state, parsing backend instructions and presenting concise video timeline summaries.
- Supports batch processing, iterative editing, and exports to various formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.).
- Guides users with status updates and handles common errors with clear feedback.
